title: High Power Auroral Stimulation (HIPAS)
short: The HIPAS (HIgh Power Auroral Stimulation) Observatory was a research facility, built to study the ionosphere and its influence on radio communications. It was located 25 miles east of Fairbanks, Alaska in the Fairbanks North Star Borough area.
desc:
- 1986-2007
- Was operated by University of California, Los Angeles
- Also used [LIDAR](https://www.sigidwiki.com/wiki/LIDAR) at times (unknown freq)
